policy: Diagnostic host echo attribution. Fit a 128 ms causal linear filter on the first 4 seconds at 4 kHz; validate on the next 750 ms. At a wake clock require at least 90% variance explained in each of the last two 160 ms windows, with RMS at least 64. Validation requires 80% and RMS 64. No new delay. A static path, known panel-only calibration and aligned reference are assumptions. Ordinary voices, gains and controls are reused. Apply only at actual detector clocks. A notification during simultaneous mentions can belong to either source.
